experiment: fractal-map 174k zoom-quality with accepted evaluation metadata
hypothesis: The 5-level compressed resolution ladder [0.25,0.5,1.0,2.0,3.0] built on full-corpus TF-IDF representations (174126 real decision IDs) recovers Swiss federal court legal structure at scale: cluster purity w.r.t. accepted metadata labels (branch, legal_area) monotonically increases from coarse to fine resolution, and zoom transitions show net positive purity improvement (zoom coherence) for decision-mappable 174k modes.
metric_branch: mean cluster branch purity per resolution; exclude 'unknown'; report coverage
metric_area: mean cluster legal_area purity per resolution (214 raw areas); exclude 'unknown'; report coverage
metric_zoom: per transition (r_i -> r_{i+1}): mean improvement (child purity - parent purity weighted appropriately) and improvement_rate (fraction of parents with improvement > 0); aggregate over parents with >=3 labeled children
success_rule: PASS iff for the production default mode cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5_174k_v25: (a) mean branch purity at res_3.0 > mean branch purity at res_0.25; (b) mean area purity at res_3.0 > mean area purity at res_0.25; (c) zoom improvement_rate > 0.5 for at least 2 of 4 transitions (branch). Secondary: compare all 4 modes; report any mode that fails monotonicity.
baseline: Uniform-random clustering baseline: expected purity = 1/n_classes (branch: ~1/5 useful classes ~0.20 excl unknown; area: ~1/214 ~0.0047). Purity must be substantially above these to be informative.
provenance_notes: Only 4 of 6 true-174k dirs are decision-mappable; cited_decisions_tfidf_174k_compressed_v25 and outcome_tfidf_174k_compressed_v25 use placeholder ids -> excluded.
Computation joins decision_clusters.json (174126 keys) with accepted metadata (173963) by decision_id; no reliance on 175440-row label arrays or embedding-row alignment.
Previously stored branch_coherence in 174k builds used a different metadata source at build time; this experiment is the first legal_area-level 174k evaluation against ACCEPTED metadata.
